FOUND s499g by the --all --quick companion (snapshot io/through.t 942/0 OK -> TRANSPILE; io/crlf_through.t 942/0 OK -> DIFF 0/0 'no kid script', it `do`es through.t).  A/B'd: identical on a 7b74e399 extraction, so NOT s499g's; BISECTED over 251 first-parent commits 4429126a..1b0baa7c to 203ac798 `s494p WIP member 3: the str-buffer licence stops depending on the loop's spelling (#2098)` (merged s498 as b6560c21; the s498 review's companion did not catch it).

Minimal reproducer (perl 5.40.3 prints `ok`):

    my $t1 = { d => 1 };
    $_->{a} = 1,
      $_->{b} = 2
        for (); # $t1
    print "ok\n";

PCL: `Parser2: empty expression at Pl/Parser2.pm line 11907` (the whole file fails to transpile).  The source is t/io/through.t:26-28 (`... for (); # $t1, $t2;`).  Likely the new licence scan lowers the EMPTY foreach list through _lower_expr without the empty-list case.
BAR: the two files back to 942/0 (splice the snapshot rows), a Pl/t guard row with the reproducer (inverse-verified), corpus-diff explained.
PRIORITY: HIGH (a regression of 1884 companion rows; a transpile DEATH, not a wrong value).

=== DONE (s499i) ===
Fixed in Pl::Parser::_desugar_loop_modifiers: a parenthesised LIST keeps its own parens only when NON-empty; an empty one is wrapped to (()) -- the block spelling `for () {...}` is a perl SYNTAX error (the while() modifier was already wrapped because PPI gives it a Condition). for/foreach/while never run, until () loops forever, as perl. Commits a71f1a6b (fix, gen v2-2680, artifacts) + 472c827f (records).
